name: Start
title: Start by *creating a blank project*
lede: For this tutorial, we start with a blank project, only a backend with no pages yet.
fig: A blank project with only one specific config file and a folder for your domains.
aside: Add --app next, nuxt, react or svelte to the command and the same project comes with pages. Every step below stays the same.
install: npm create fougere my-blog --blank && cd my-blog && npm install
